svg.text: claudia creates — templates from a PowerPoint file, slides that differ, a new presentation (E10.3–E10.5)
For review before any code. Content and file names are invented. The import step is part of the import screen being designed with another agent; this is only its templates step.
G · Opening a PowerPoint file: its masters become templates
PowerPoint keeps a master per pasted slide when “Keep source formatting” was used. claudia compares them
and proposes as few templates as the design really has. Nothing is merged without the person's yes.
This file has 14 slide masters with 31 layouts. 13 masters look the same — colours, fonts, background and slot positions —
and differ only in their names. Its 20 slides use 10 of the layouts.
→ one template “Custom Design” with 9 layouts, for 19 slides
Identical: colours, fonts, background, every slot's place and style.
differs in: background picture, title font
or: merge into “Custom Design” as a named variant
Bring over the 21 layouts no slide uses
Off: they stay in the file (an edited file keeps them) but do not clutter the layout picker.
The font “Aptos” is not on this server: the slides show it in Inter until it is installed (Tools ▸ Font manager…).
Proposal D375, for the owner to decide: one template per design, not per master.
H · Slides that differ from their layout
From the dot on a slide tab, or “3 slides differ” in the template band. Only places
and sizes can differ: a look that differs is a named style (D75, D306).
Picture moved out of its slot
“Put it back” returns the object to its slot (one command, undoable).
“Make the layout so…” moves the slot in the template, for every slide
with this layout; the dialog names how many slides change.
“Variant…” is panel F of mock-up 2: a named layout with this difference.
A slide that differs is not an error: the list only makes it visible, so a
deck stays consistent on purpose. Screen readers hear “differs from its
layout” after the slide's layout name.
I · File ▸ New: from a template, or from what the presentation should achieve
Nothing is required (D71): “Start empty” is one click. The question is offered once; its answer is document metadata and may suggest a template and an outline.
What would you like to achieve with it?
Win the council's support for the new cycle lanes
Suggested from your answer: the template Lecture, and an outline —
The outline becomes slides with titles in the matching layouts; nothing else is written.
The suggestion comes from the ai user if one is set up; without it, from the template's own outline.
